Class PayingCustomer

java.lang.Object
ict373assignment1q2.Customer
ict373assignment1q2.PayingCustomer
public class PayingCustomer extends Customer
Represents a paying customer. A paying customer pays for their own subscription and can have associate customers linked to their account.
